sloka: रुधिरोक्षितगात्रस्य बभूव पतितं द्विधा ।सरोषपरिवृत्ताक्षं शुभं खड्गहतं शिरः ।। ६.५४.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: rudhirokṣitagātrasya babhūva patitaṁ dvidhā ।saroṣaparivṛttākṣaṁ śubhaṁ khaḍgahataṁ śiraḥ ।। 6.54.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Deluded with fear, the Rakshasas seeing Vajradamshtra killed by monkeys, panic stricken, heads bent in shame, faces woebegone fled to Lanka.
